title: Floral Jhumka
description: Add a touch of elegance to your look with these beautifully handcrafted resin jhumkas. Made with love and attention to detail, each pair is lightweight, unique, and perfect for both everyday wear and special occasions. The delicate floral design and vibrant colors make them a charming accessory that complements ethnic as well as fusion outfits.

details.processDescription: Crafted from locally sourced stoneware clay. The exterior features a matte, slightly toothy finish while the interior is glazed with a clear, water-tight coating.
details.artistNote: This vase was born from a desire to capture the fleeting, translucent quality of a fern leaf catching the morning light. The painting process is meditative, requiring a steady hand and a quiet mind.

title: Daisy in the Dark
description: Delicate white daisies blooming against a sleek black backdrop — these handcrafted resin jhumkas are the perfect blend of elegance and charm. Lightweight, unique, and lovingly handmade, they're designed to add a touch of floral magic to every outfit. Whether you're dressing up for a festive occasion or adding a statement piece to your everyday look, these jhumkas are sure to turn heads.

details.processDescription: Built up in layers over several weeks, each medium is allowed to fully cure before the next is applied. The raw linen adds warmth and texture that a primed canvas cannot replicate.
details.artistNote: Midnight blooms are the ones nobody sees — they open in secret and close before dawn. This piece is my meditation on unseen beauty.

title: Raw Earth Pitcher
description: A sculptural pitcher left intentionally unglazed to celebrate the raw beauty of stoneware. The exterior retains the maker's marks and the subtle texture of the clay body.

details.care: Interior glazed for water-tightness; hand wash exterior
details.processDescription: Coil-built and paddle-formed, this pitcher is fired to cone 10 in a wood-fired kiln. The ash from the firing leaves natural deposits on the raw exterior.
details.artistNote: I wanted to make a pitcher that felt ancient — like something unearthed rather than made. Leaving it raw was the only honest choice.

title: Ochre Fragment
description: A deconstructed wall sculpture evoking geological strata. Iron oxide washes in deep ochre and burnt sienna create an earthy, grounding presence on any wall.

details.care: Dust with soft brush; wall-mount hardware included
details.processDescription: Slabs of clay are torn and layered while wet, then allowed to dry slowly to preserve the organic edges. Multiple iron oxide washes are applied between firings to build color depth.
details.artistNote: I think of these as fossils from a world that never existed — fragments of an imagined geology.
